architecture_upgrade: CCCXXXI identified the RG renderer as a Lorentzian spinor generator. CCCXXXII factors the scalar mass-shell equation through first-order finite Dirac operators D±G, so the renderer now has a Dirac/Klein-Gordon layer.

honesty_boundary: This is a finite Dirac/Klein-Gordon factorization for the RG spinor flow, not yet a continuum relativistic field equation in physical spacetime.
theorem: Because G^2=(5049/4)I, the spinor transport equation d psi/dt=G psi squares to d^2 psi/dt^2=(5049/4)psi.  Equivalently, (D-G)(D+G)=D^2-(5049/4)I.  The projective W33 RG renderer therefore admits a finite Dirac factorization with mass sqrt(5049)/2.
title: Finite Dirac Factorization Compiler
